components.name: Date picker
components.description: Date picker — choose a date (Single), a period (Range) or scroll a wheel (Wheel, compact for birthdays and far dates). Month grid Monday-first with today dot, past dates disabled, range band in accent/subtle. Lives in a Bottom sheet on mobile and a Popover on web.
